reader.notes: NearestDeclaring narrows the qualified survivors to the nearest declaring depth and leaves two survivors of one tier to the caller's ambiguity verdict; the cross-class hides (condition-name, file-name, report entry) apply the same nearest-element rule across name classes. The ambiguity text counts all three declarations rather than the two local ones, a wording point only.
